themes_detail.label: Unleashed Dogs Surge
themes_detail.summary: Unleashed dog complaints spiked to 5 reports this week versus a 0.8 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks—a 567% increase (z-score: 3.9)—suggesting either a sudden enforcement gap or organized problem in this Queens Village/Cambria Heights community.
evidence: 5 unleashed dog complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.8 weekly average (8-week baseline)
567% spike with z-score of 3.9 (high statistical significance)
Represents a 6-fold increase in a single week
reporting_angles: Interview residents affected by unleashed dogs; identify specific locations and whether complaints cluster geographically
Contact NYPD Animal Care & Control to determine if there's a known pack or enforcement response to the spike

themes_detail.label: Illegal Tree Damage Spike
themes_detail.summary: Illegal tree damage complaints jumped to 4 reports this week from a 0.8 weekly average—a 433% spike (z-score: 4.91)—pointing to possible unlicensed tree work or property damage in the district.
evidence: 4 illegal tree damage complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.8 weekly average (8-week baseline)
433% increase with z-score of 4.91 (high statistical significance)
Aligns with community board budget requests for better park maintenance and tree management
reporting_angles: Locate specific addresses of complaints; identify whether same contractor or property owner involved in multiple cases
Contact NYC Parks enforcement to determine if they've launched investigation; explore licensing requirements for tree work

themes_detail.label: Asbestos Exposure Concerns
themes_detail.summary: Asbestos complaints reached 3 reports last week versus a 0.4 weekly average over 8 weeks—a 700% spike (z-score: 5.42)—suggesting potential building violations or renovation hazards in Queens Village/Cambria Heights.
evidence: 3 asbestos complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.4 weekly average (8-week baseline)
700% spike with z-score of 5.42 (highest severity rating in dataset)
643 building permit filings in last 90 days, with 436 alterations—potential source of asbestos disturbance
reporting_angles: Request DOB data on which buildings generated asbestos complaints; cross-reference with active alteration permits to identify problem properties
Interview residents living near complaint addresses; contact NYC Department of Environmental Protection and NYC Health on asbestos remediation protocols

themes_detail.label: Vendor Enforcement Crackdown
themes_detail.summary: Vendor enforcement complaints surged to 4 reports this week from a 0.5 weekly average—a 700% spike (z-score: 4.95)—indicating either increased street vending or stepped-up city enforcement activity in the district.
evidence: 4 vendor enforcement complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.5 weekly average (8-week baseline)
700% spike with z-score of 4.95 (high statistical significance)
No prior local news or Reddit discussion suggests this is underreported
reporting_angles: Contact NYPD Neighborhoods Policing Team and Department of Consumer Affairs on vendor enforcement initiatives or complaints
Interview street vendors in district to understand scope and whether complaints reflect legitimate vending disputes or displacement

themes_detail.label: Overgrown Trees & Branches Surge
themes_detail.summary: Overgrown tree and branch complaints jumped to 12 reports this week from a 5.4 weekly average—a 123% increase (z-score: 3.55)—suggesting seasonal growth or deferred maintenance across parks and public spaces.
evidence: 12 overgrown tree/branch complaints THIS WEEK vs. 5.4 weekly average (8-week baseline)
123% spike with z-score of 3.55 (high statistical significance)
Community board has repeatedly requested better park maintenance funding (repeated budget request)
reporting_angles: Contact NYC Parks on maintenance schedules and staffing levels; determine if complaints cluster in specific parks or neighborhoods
Photograph affected areas; frame story around deferred maintenance and community board budget advocacy
